intervention: Pair fixed global single-axis TLS and guide-direction block readers on each complete immutable base and saved candidate inside the identical original RGB mask. Guidance defines direction, not position or target identity. No refit, patch rewrite, camera replacement, retuning or new sampling policy.
repeat_policy: Two fresh reader-only subprocesses. The exact same original one-per-object DA3 predictions and eight patches are reused. This is not an independent end-to-end reconstruction repeat.
evaluation_policy: All prior object development scores have been seen; this is not blind. Inference still forbids truth/score access. Require all 80 normal rows and every frozen point/patch receipt before this run accesses object truth. Score common outputs and ten unchanged native added-curve arms separately; preserve every rejection, empty output and error.
qualification: Previously seen synthetic development evidence, not blind or real-capture evidence and not G1 qualification. Common readout uses only original image-guide and exported-camera direction for axial blocks, never guide position to choose a rod or native candidate geometry to choose support. Original RGB volume, complete base, sampling, scales, native geometry and all empty/rejected/error rows stay unchanged.
